newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to quote air transit fees in dollars.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to quote air transit fees in dollars.

text.p: Bulgaria will quote its fees for overflights in dollars and will raise airport fees for international flights from 1,875 levs to $8 per passenger effective Tuesday, officials said on Monday.
The director general of the air traffic service Valentin Valkov said the change was due to the sharp depreciation of the lev.

"We are introducing a scheme quoted in dollars following the recommendations of the European Investment Bank, which extended us a $30 million Ecu ($24.1 million) loan for improving the efficiency and capacity of Bulgaria's air traffic control system," Valkov told Reuters.
The air traffic service will collect fees from foreign carriers in dollars and Bulgarian airlines will pay in levs at the lev/dollar rate for the day.

Sofia airport officials said the airport fee for international flights would rise to $8 per passenger, while for internal flights it would rise to $1.50 per passenger from 250 levs. Bulgarians will pay its lev equivalent, they added.
The lev slumped to around 500 levs per dollar on the interbank forex market on Monday from around 470 last Friday and around 365 at the end of November.
